definitions.explanation: Pretending to be ill, usually to get out of school, work or some duty.

examples.japanese: {仮病|けびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{腹痛|ふくつう}→腹痛：05019_fukutsuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{仮病|けびょう}だった。
⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{仮病|けびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}もう→休む：00606_yasumu⟧とした。
examples.english: On the day of the test, he tried to stay home from school by pretending to be sick.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- {仮病|けびょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to fake being sick
- {仮病|けびょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧: to take a day off by faking illness
- {仮病|けびょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ばれる→ばれる：06721_bareru⟧: to be found out faking

WATCH OUT:
- The reading is けびょう, not ⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧びょう: {仮|け} is a special reading found in this word.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ずる{休|やす}み→ずる休み：33488_zuruyasumi⟧: skipping school or work without a good reason; {仮病|けびょう} is one way of doing it
